name: allenlabs-memory
description: Route agent memory to Cloudflare Agent Memory or an operator-configured Seoul PostgreSQL service.

interface.shortDescription: Choose a memory destination before sending content.
interface.longDescription: Explicit memory routing with separate credentials for Cloudflare Agent Memory and a Seoul PostgreSQL service. Uncertain or region-locked content stays in Seoul. Medical Cloudflare transfers require server-verified consent.
defaultPrompt: Classify this memory and choose its storage destination.
Find relevant memories using the required storage location.
